metadata.title: Dose-dense Methotrexate, Vinblastine, Doxorubicin and Cisplatin (MVAC) – 14 day
metadata.short_title: Dose-dense Methotrexate, Vinblastine, Doxorubicin and Cisplatin (MVAC) – 14 day
metadata.indication: Neoadjuvant or advanced urothelial carcinoma treated with dose-dense MVAC.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00333 Version 5a. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: Neoadjuvant or advanced urothelial carcinoma treated with dose-dense MVAC.

treatment.schedule_summary: Dose-dense MVAC every 14 days with G-CSF support.
